owner.settings.googleReviews.title: Google Reviews sync
owner.settings.googleReviews.lede: Paste your Google Place ID, then click Sync now to pull the latest reviews into this section. Re-run any time — repeated syncs upsert by review identity so duplicates don't accumulate.
owner.settings.googleReviews.ledeNoKey: The platform isn't configured with a Google Places API key. Ask your developer to set GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY in the server environment, then redeploy. You can still save your Place ID below — Sync becomes available once the key is live.
owner.settings.googleReviews.placeIdHint: Paste a Google Maps share link (https://maps.app.goo.gl/…) or the raw Place ID. We follow the redirect server-side and extract the ID for you.
owner.settings.googleReviews.zeroNoRevie: Google has no reviews for this place yet. Once customers leave reviews on Google Maps, Sync now will pull them in.
owner.settings.googleReviews.zeroNoSku: Google reports {count} rating(s) for this place, but the Places API returned no review bodies. The most common cause is that the configured GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY does not have the Places API (New) Enterprise SKU enabled — review bodies are gated behind that tier. Enable it in the Google Cloud Console for the project that owns the key.
owner.settings.googleReviews.zeroEmptyBo: Google returned {n} review(s) but all had empty text bodies (ratings only). Nothing to display.
owner.settings.googleReviews.zeroGeneric: Google returned {fetched} review(s) out of {total} total ratings, but none could be imported. Check the server logs for details.
owner.settings.googleReviews.pendingHint: Saved as a Maps URL — Sync now will resolve it to a clean Place ID once the API key is configured.
owner.settings.googleReviews.autoSyncHin: Once a day the server pulls the latest reviews from Google and adds any new ones. Each row upserts in place — re-runs don't create duplicates. Manual Sync now still works any time you want a fresh pull.
